1.
Exemptions are allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Applications stand disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No. 392/2012 PS Sultanpuri under sections 406/498A/34 I.P.C and section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide settlement deed dated 9th May, 2022 which is on record of this Court.

2. Petitioner Nos.1 to 5 and respondent no.2-complainant are present in the Court and all of them have been duly identified by their respective counsels as well as the IO.
3.

As per the FIR, petitioner no.1 was married to respondent no.2 on 24th April, 1999 but due to disputes and differences, the marriage was dissolved by mutual consent vide decree of divorce dated 10th January, 2023.
Two children were born out of this wedlock.
4. As per the settlement a balance sum of Rs.50,000/- is to be paid to respondent no.2 at this stage.
Same is being tendered by way of a Demand Draft No. 933306 dated 15th February, 2023 draw on Union Bank which is duly accepted and acknowledged by her in the Court today.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
